text: Only introduce Savings Plus after the customer has confirmed the complaint is resolved. Acknowledge the resolution first. Position Savings Plus as a way to earn interest on balances above 1000 EUR. Refer to the published rate sheet; never quote or promise a rate.
Savings Plus may be offered when the customer holds a current account and discusses saving or balances. Present it as optional. Refer to the published rate sheet; never quote or promise a rate.
Premium Card includes travel benefits and carries an annual fee that must always be disclosed before the customer agrees.
Travel Insurance may be suggested when the customer mentions travel or card use abroad. Coverage terms must be sent in writing.
